newsitem.title: USA: Union Dominion files $600 million shelf.
newsitem.headline: Union Dominion files $600 million shelf.

text.p: United Dominion Realty Trust Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission a shelf registration to sell up to $600 million in debt securities, preferred and common stock.
When combined with previous registrations, United will have a total offering of $674,842,500 worth of securities available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, the company said.

United Dominion, based in Richmond, Va., is a self-administered Real Estate Investment Trust, which acquires, develops and manages apartment homes for its own portfolio in the sunbelt region of the United States.
